design: A massive angular rock elemental, broad humanoid torso made of grey granite slabs and dark slate joints, large boulder shoulders, a blocky small head, TWO thick rock arms with huge blunt fists and TWO stumpy heavy stone legs. Narrow blue glowing eye slits and a stern jagged mouth groove, one embedded blue core in chest, restrained carved geometric runes. Different from clay golem: sharp faceted granite rather than rounded orange clay. Solid connected construct, no floating stones, no crystals hovering, no debris effects. Painted stylized 2D fantasy brute matching player art, imposing not adorable. Idle firmly planted and settling; hurt rocks backward with fists close; attack winds one fist then punches toward RIGHT; dodge braces low and leans backward. Same rock silhouette and two-arm/two-leg anatomy all16poses, generous margins.

Fun to fight, not adorable, not a friendly pet or baby mascot. Medium-size angular eyes, pointed brows, toothy crooked smirk. NO giant sparkling puppy eyes, NO blush, NO rosy cheeks, NO tiny sweet smile, NO cuddly baby proportions. Avoid grimdark photorealism, horror and gore as well. Use readable hand-painted/cel-shaded surfaces and confident outlines matching the player reference. Transparent empty background. Every subject entirely within its own equal cell, generous empty padding between figures. Make each entire creature INCLUDING weapons/tail/wings occupy at most 70% of its cell WIDTH and 60% HEIGHT, with wide transparent margins on all four sides. No ghost copies or motion streaks.
Keep every frame FULL BODY and the same zoom. Transparent background with real alpha, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadows, no captions, no frame borders, no UI. This is high-detail NEW art, not enlarged old pixel art.
